description: Short public YouTube videos (1 to 4 minutes) with creator-uploaded captions in a known language. The creator captions are the reference for word and character error rates of each speech-to-text rung. Ordered so the first three cover English, German and a stage talk.

items.title: How Do We Know the Earth Isn't Flat? We Asked a NASA Expert
items.why: Unscripted expert answer to camera, light background music; short, so it is first and makes --limit runs cheap.
items.license: NASA video: NASA media is generally not subject to US copyright (NASA media usage guidelines). Reference captions are committed in datasets/refs/.

items.title: Deutsch lernen mit Videos | Kurz und leicht vom 30.06.2026 | mit deutschen Untertiteln
items.why: German news read slowly for learners; checks a non-English language early in the list.
items.license: Standard YouTube license. Reference captions are downloaded at run time and cached locally (.vid2context/cache/evals/refs/), not stored in this repo.

items.title: A one minute TEDx Talk for the digital age | Woody Roseland | TEDxMileHigh
items.why: Fast stage speech with audience reactions and a live-room acoustic.
items.license: TED content, shared under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 per TED's usage policy (attribution: TED). Reference captions are committed in datasets/refs/.
